case: a query that opens with WITH

habits.streaks.statement: WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT d + 1 FROM days WHERE d < 30) SELECT d FROM days LIMIT 30

error: Action habits.streaks is a query, so it must start with SELECT. Move the WITH clause into a subquery, as in SELECT ... FROM (WITH ... SELECT ...).

case: the same CTE inside a subquery

habits.streaks.statement: SELECT d FROM (WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT d + 1 FROM days WHERE d < 30) SELECT d FROM days) LIMIT 30

case: a mutation that opens with WITH

bookings.create.statement: WITH span(slot) AS (SELECT 9) INSERT INTO bookings (slot, user_id) SELECT slot, ?1 FROM span

error: Action bookings.create is a mutation, so it must start with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE. Put the WITH clause after INSERT INTO <table> (<columns>), or inside a subquery.

case: the same CTE after INSERT INTO

bookings.create.statement: INSERT INTO bookings (slot, user_id) WITH span(slot) AS (SELECT 9) SELECT slot, ?1 FROM span

case: a second statement

bookings.cancel.statement: UPDATE bookings SET cancelled_at = 1 WHERE user_id = ?1; INSERT INTO log (user_id) VALUES (?1)

error: Action bookings.cancel must contain one statement.

case: a second semicolon

bookings.cancel.statement: UPDATE bookings SET cancelled_at = 1 WHERE user_id = ?1;;

error: Action bookings.cancel must contain one statement.

case: a semicolon inside a string

notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes (body, user_id) VALUES ('a; b', ?1)

case: a trailing semicolon and a comment

notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes (body, user_id) VALUES ('a', ?1); -- done

case: a comment before SELECT

notes.list.statement: /* newest first */ SELECT id FROM notes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

case: a trigger written as an action

bookings.log.statement: CREATE TRIGGER log_bookings AFTER INSERT ON bookings BEGIN INSERT INTO log (user_id) VALUES (NEW.user_id); END

error: Action bookings.log is a mutation, so it must start with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE. Tables and indexes belong in schema.sql, and Littlebox runs no triggers or views.

case: a view written as an action

bookings.taken.statement: CREATE VIEW taken AS SELECT room_id FROM bookings

error: Action bookings.taken is a query, so it must start with SELECT. Tables and indexes belong in schema.sql, and Littlebox runs no triggers or views.

case: a SELECT declared as a mutation

notes.add.statement: SELECT id FROM notes WHERE user_id = ?1 LIMIT 1

error: Action notes.add is a mutation, so it must start with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE.

case: RETURNING on a mutation

notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes (body, user_id) VALUES ('a', ?1) RETURNING id

error: Action notes.add cannot use RETURNING. Mutations return changes and lastInsertId; use a query to read rows.

case: RETURNING as a named parameter
a window function without a LIMIT

habits.streaks.statement: SELECT habit_id, max(run) AS best FROM (SELECT habit_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY habit_id ORDER BY day) AS run FROM checkins) GROUP BY habit_id

error: Action habits.streaks uses OVER, which keeps one result row per stored row, and has no LIMIT. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a window function with a LIMIT

habits.streaks.statement: SELECT habit_id, max(run) AS best FROM (SELECT habit_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY habit_id ORDER BY day) AS run FROM checkins) GROUP BY habit_id LIMIT 100

case: schema.sql with tables and indexes
schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, cancelled_at INTEGER);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bookings_one_holder ON bookings (room_id, day, slot) WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL;

case: schema.sql with a trigger
error: schema.sql may only create tables and indexes, but it contains CREATE TRIGGER.

case: schema.sql with a view
schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, cancelled_at INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS taken AS SELECT room_id FROM bookings WHERE cancelled_at IS NULL;
error: schema.sql may only create tables and indexes, but it contains CREATE VIEW.

case: schema.sql with a trigger and a view
error: schema.sql may only create tables and indexes, but it contains CREATE VIEW, CREATE TRIGGER.

case: schema.sql that seeds a row
schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rooms (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO rooms (name) VALUES ('Atlas');
error: schema.sql may only create tables and indexes, but it contains INSERT.

case: a query that reads rows with no LIMIT

orders.list.statement: SELECT id, external_id FROM orders ORDER BY id DESC

error: Action orders.list reads rows and has no LIMIT. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a LIMIT inside a string does not count

orders.list.statement: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE note = 'LIMIT 5'

error: Action orders.list reads rows and has no LIMIT. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a LIMIT inside a comment does not count
error: Action orders.list reads rows and has no LIMIT. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a LIMIT inside a subquery does not count

orders.list.statement: SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM orders LIMIT 1)

error: Action orders.list reads rows and has no LIMIT. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a grouped query with no LIMIT

orders.list.statement: SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY user_id

error: Action orders.list groups rows and has no LIMIT, so the result can grow with the data. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: a compound query with no LIMIT on the whole result

orders.list.statement: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM orders UNION ALL SELECT count(*) AS n FROM notes

error: Action orders.list combines more than one query and has no LIMIT on the whole result. Add a LIMIT. A total (count, sum, avg, min or max) with no GROUP BY does not need one.

case: totals with no GROUP BY need no LIMIT

orders.list.statement: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(total) s FROM orders

case: a query that reads no table needs no LIMIT
a top-level LIMIT

orders.list.statement: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
